programme.title: The Pure And The Evil

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Martial arts legend Chan Koon Tai plays a city gang leader, who runs his operation out of a local cafe in this gritty, crime drama from director Kuei Chih Hung.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Chen Hou is a chauffeur who gets caught in a mistaken identity scandal linking him to businesswoman Lok Dai. When a rumor gets out that the two are involved in an affair, shes angry and confronts him.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Several years before GHOSTBUSTERS was a massive Hollywood hit, Wong Jing scripted this hilarious supernatural action comedy starring Alexander Fu and directed by Lau Ka Wing.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport vampires for a living. When two of them hopped away, it is revealed that one of them is actually a man in disguise trying to escape from his enemies.

programme.title: Call To Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: The glorious Betty Loh Ti stars as a beauty who disguises herself as a boy in order to receive a forbidden education in this multi award-winning drama from director Li Han Hsiang.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chiefs illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his fathers death.

programme.title: Between Tears And Smiles
programme.desc: Kwan Shan must save the woman he loves (Li Li-hua), before she is presented as a gift to the General!

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is one of the Flying Guillotine Squad, a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When he starts to question the morality of his missions, he becomes a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: Beloved cult director Kueh Chih Hung delivers this deranged romantic tragedy centring on muscular demon Lo Meng, whose attempts to possess the soul of his true love backfire.

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: Chang Chehs The Water Margin is the martial arts epic of epics. Based on the true legend of how 108 rebels in the mountains were able to repeatedly defeat invading Sung armies.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu depicts the glamourous world of nightclub performers in this story about two struggling sisters, played by Irene Chen Yi Ling and Betty Ting Pei.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks trusted friend Wang to protect his family while hes away, but Wang rapes his wife, kills his servants and has Lis convoy attacked. Li fears his daughter is still in peril!

programme.title: The Venus Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus Tear Diamond.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: After his hit directorial debut Lets Make Laugh, Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns with this comedic clash of cultures when a Mainland Chinese peasant takes his family to Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: Humiliated swordsman Chin Wu-hsin is charged with finding the Supreme Sword of Old Eagle, only to retrieve it using foul play. This leads Old Eagles own son to avenge his father.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: Yu Nan (Yi Lei) is a compulsive gambler. He makes his wife as a down payment for his debt, feeling regretted and decides to kill himself but stops when a beautiful ghost appears.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clans disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score The Proud One. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clans leader.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Ti Lung undergoes a role change to be a helpless man under the spell of an evil witch doctor. A major supernatural battle ensues as this bone-chilling tale of good vs evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: A dedicated wife uncovers a web of blackmail and deceit after her husband is conned by a conniving belly dancer. When the dancer is stabbed, things quickly go from bad to insane.

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns to defend the family homestead against Japanese financiers. Once back, Yen faces romantic complications as well as marauding, murderers villains.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: In the waning day of the Ching Dynasty, the son of the local magistrate murdered a peddler and raped his wife. The wife had been framed for her husbands murder by the rapist.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Its a no-holds-barred battle to the death for possession of the invaluable Purple Sword. Assistant director Wang Po-yi also wrote this entertaining and exciting adventure.

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Legendary actress Lin Feng Jiao stars in this romantic comedy as an unlikely romance occurs between an entrepreneurs son and a kindergartens principals niece.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: Popular Shaw Bros actress Li Jing stars as an innkeepers daughter in a rural mountain town who witnesses unspeakable acts committed by one of the resident, in this harrowing drama.

programme.title: The Duel Of The Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel.

programme.title: The Bride From Hell
programme.desc: The 70s idol Hsing Hui and Yon Fan star in this horror movie. Young business man marries pretty, young bride, never knowing that she carries the spirit and everything starts there.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful young fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealousy and a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. She asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead.

programme.title: The Protectors

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: Two young men become involved in a complicated crime involving antique watches.

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love.

programme.title: The Infernal Walker
programme.desc: Ting is an undercover police who infiltrates a triad and Tuen is a triad mole being planted into the police force. While Tang is tired of being an undercover cop, Tuen wishes to quit the triad and become a real police. When the triad boss sets a trap to uncover the moles identity, the two must fight for themselves.

programme.title: See You Tomorrow
programme.desc: Chen and his partner Guan are legendary navigators, but in the process of helping a girl Xiao Yu, they must also face their own problems.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: The story revolves around a dutiful yet indifferent fireman, who can march into disaster and risk his lives by saving others, yet would he have the equivalent courage to tackle his personal issues?

programme.title: Mission Milano
programme.desc: A wealthy entrepreneur goes undercover with an Interpol agent to protect a new invention, the Seed of God, from falling into an international crime conglomerate.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar owner befriends a drunken woman and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs.

programme.title: One And Only
programme.desc: Veteran street dancer Ding Lei, invites passionate street dancer, Chen Shuo to his dance club. Sparks fly when Chen dances with the club’s top dancers. Chen pursues his dream to perform but discovers that Ding has invited him for another reason. As both of them deal with hard times, can they turn the tide on the challenges that they are facing?

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: Quan Dao: Journey Of A Boxer
programme.desc: When Xings son attempts drug trafficking to save his fathers studio but fails and is brutally beaten up, Ah Niu accepts a death combat challenge so as to help him take revenge.

programme.title: Tales From Occult: Malevolence
programme.desc: The final chapter of Tales From The Occult, features three short stories. The stories reveal the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Love After Love
programme.desc: Wei Long travels to HK from Shanghai to pursue her education. As she struggles financially, she becomes her aunts puppet to lure rich men. When Wei Long falls for playboy, George, she sinks in a life of depravity.

programme.title: Knight Of Shadows: Yin and Yang
programme.desc: Pu Song Ling, a legendary demon hunter, is asked to investigate a case involving missing teenage village girls with Constable Yan Fei and accidentally discover a mysterious love between a knight and a female ghost.

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: An irritable elderly man joins a team rescuing stray dogs. As they work together to save abandoned animals, the groups efforts demonstrate how compassion can change lives for both humans and canines.

programme.title: Adventure Of The King
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor Zhengde flees the palace to see the world after his mother orders him to marry an ugly princess. He disguises as a commoner and escapes with his advisors, but a gambling mishap causes them to part ways and Zhengde lost all his money. Phoenix, the owner of Lung Fung Inn, takes him in out of pity, and thus begins his new adventure...

programme.title: The Narrow Road
programme.desc: A small cleaning company owner hits tough times during the pandemic. In need of an assistant, he hires a young single mother who unexpectedly helps him solve many difficulties at work.

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette
programme.desc: A retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian man who carries a bag of stolen drugs.

programme.title: Everything Under Control
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, one of the security escorts, Jelly, steals the diamonds and flees. Fellow security escorts, Yau Shing and Penguin, are forced to help the robber track down the diamonds. They stumble onto a remote village along the way, encountering strange villagers and mysterious incidents. Can they finally locate Jelly and the diamonds?

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Fai, once a world champion in boxing, escapes to Macau from the loan sharks and unexpectedly encounters Qi, a young chap who is determined to win a boxing match.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: As the police sets to arrest a drug lord, a team of masked thugs steals the drugs. Inspector Bong discovers that the killers are led by Ngo, a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him.

programme.title: YUM Investigation
programme.desc: Yum, a detective agency that handles supernatural cases, investigates the evil spirits appearing in an old building. They discover that the spirits are created so that the building can be vacated for redevelopment.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tung’s mad fate?

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at funding risk, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match and save it.

programme.title: We Are Family
programme.desc: Jia-cong, who came from a broken family, and Pei-yi, a single mother who had little talent on the entertainment road, founded a company that can provide "rental family" services.

programme.title: Dont Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao suffers from amnesia and forgets about everything that happens yesterday when he wakes up the next day. When Lu Yao meets psychotherapist Xing Yue, they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: A debt-ridden wedding planner inadvertently becomes a successful funeral planner, but he must convince a traditional Taoist priest of his legitimacy to continue operating in the field.

programme.title: Sky On Fire
programme.desc: A security guard becomes embroiled in a battle to protect stem cell research, which can potentially cure cancer, from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: The Battle At Lake Changjin
programme.desc: Set in the winter of 1950, a pivotal battle begins at the freezing Lake Changjin region. Facing extreme cold, hunger and weaker weapons, the Chinese troops nonetheless forge ahead.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A killer and a stage actor accidentally swapped their identities at a bathhouse. When the killer strives to become a successful stage actor, he also starts to recall what has happened.

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: After a brutal beating, Chet falls into a coma. In a dream world, he trains with Sifu Turtle in Burmese boxing to defeat a villain, while his fate hinges on his mothers actions in the real world.

programme.title: Shock Wave 2
programme.desc: A series of bomb explosions is causing fear in Hong Kong. Former bomb specialist Feng is found in coma at the crime scene and becomes a suspect. To prove his innocence, he seeks help from his former partner Wen. However, it seems revealing the truth is as risky as disposing a bomb…

programme.title: Mamas Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: Hackers have caused a large-scale cyber attack and Chuns boss is the mastermind of the attack. When Chun gets trapped in a money laundering operation, he must fight to prove his innocence in the cyber world.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Waters ex-girlfriend asked him to take care of their autistic son. As Water lives with his son, he discovers his sons talent in running, Water decides to give up his dissipated life and support his sons dream.

programme.title: Love Never Ends
programme.desc: An empty-nest elderly man and a widowed elderly woman who collects scrap, meet unexpectedly and gradually develop feelings for each other. An elderly couple whose wife suffers from a serious illness, makes a living by selling scrap. Both these elderly couples fall deeply in love and prove that love never ends, even if there is no tomorrow!

programme.title: Murder And Mayhem In Taipei
programme.desc: In this one-hour special we recount the biggest manhunt in Taiwans history, as three criminals kidnap a famous stars daughter, Bai Bing Bing. The gang rapes and murders her - sparking a yearlong violent manhunt that turns Taipei into a bloody battleground. Their rein of terror saw intense gun battles in the streets with police, multiple kidnappings, rapes and murders. No one was off limits, innocent citizens, and politicians a plastic surgeon and even a foreign diplomat. As the police close in on the three, we relive the desperate months as they evade the police before two-commit suicide and the final gang member captured during a crime that would hit the worlds headlines.

programme.title: Bing Slamet Sibuk
programme.desc: Inspired by The Sound of Music, this movie tells a story of Bing Slamet who works for Eddy Suds big family and the adoration that the children have for him for his ability to sing.

programme.title: Gentayangan
programme.desc: After being declared bankrupt by the court, Abimanyu Karindra has no choice but to bring his wife, their two children and his sister Sheila to settle in a parents hotel in a mountain valley.

programme.title: Perempuan-Perempuan Liar
programme.desc: Two crazy debt collectors, incidentally meet crazy women, Mey and Cindy. These two men are trapped in the girls game, and they take Mey off from her wedding. This runaway bride tragedy infuriates both girls father.

programme.title: Ratu Kostmopolitan
programme.desc: Three women who lives in a boarding house in Jakarta has to deal with a group of thugs who wants them out of their humble abode.

programme.title: Pesan Dari Surga
programme.desc: Five young people form a band named Topeng. A problem rises and threats the bands existence. Yet, an accident survivor wakes up from a coma and brings a message from heaven.

programme.title: Selamanya
programme.desc: Bara struggles to save Aristha from drugs and prostitution. He also saves her from a suicidal attempt, but everything ends tragically when a sick Aristha dies in Baras arms.

programme.title: Love You Love You Not
programme.desc: A romantic comedy about Amira, an English tutor, who teaches English to Juki, a hot-tempered Betawi guy, so he can follow his girlfriend to America.

programme.title: 3 Srikandi
programme.desc: Based on a true story. In 1988, Seoul Olympic, 3 female archers from Indonesia created history by winning the first medal ever for the country.

programme.title: Paku

programme.title: Kanan Kiri OK 2
programme.desc: Silly things start to happen when Tati is determined to be a movie star after learning that Anita and Rio, her neighbours, are about to star in a movie.

programme.title: Mati Muda Di Pelukan Janda
programme.desc: Rahmat was orphaned and raised by the Mba Bunga aka Mas Bambang. He secretly fall in love with Ratih. Yet another widow who lived in the area, Mpok Sari, has crush on him.

programme.title: Rumah Hantu Pasar Malam
programme.desc: A new night market mysterious pops up in a small village and, one by one, patrons begin disappearing. This doesnt dissuade five young friends from deciding to hold a birthday party there.

programme.title: Bunga Cinta Kasih
programme.desc: Gita and Trisna are elected as chairman and vice chairman of the class. Gita secretly falls in love with Trisna and the romance between them begins but her father strongly disapproves.

programme.title: Marina

programme.title: Arwah Goyang Jupe Depe
programme.desc: Lilis was forced to return to be a dancer in a jaipong dance group called Goyang Karawang. But, Neneng feels threatened by her return and tried to maintain her position.

programme.title: Ateng Minta Kawin
programme.desc: Their parents dont approve of the romance between Ateng and Vivi, so they keep their relationship a secret.

programme.desc: Astris mother demands angrily for a porn-video cassette that embarrasses the son-in-law Dedi, and the two grandchildren. In desperation, she runs away from home.

programme.desc: A football team who has differences and ego problems must win an International underground football tournament in order to save their own lives.

programme.title: Ummi Aminah

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kikos life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

Slowly, Hafizah learned that Ryans behavior was because his parents household was unhappy.
